items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: And her grandfather, a witch doctor, his name was Koosah.

ctx.x: Yes. Now, my grandfather, at times he would go by the name of Hayes, and at times he would go by the name of Baldridge. Then I was led to believe that they were two different men -- Hayes and Baldridge, two of my grandmother's husbands. And whichever one she was with, that's the name that she used.
And her grandfather, a witch doctor, his name was Koosah. How you spell it, don't ask me. Ain't my job. Koosah. (Laughs)
